ESL accepts these bookings without any risk or liability on their part, including but not limited to loss, damage, delay, detention, diversion, consequential/economic loss or damage (whether foreseeable or otherwise) or any and all other associated risks, losses or damage arising out of or in relation to the current situation in the Middle East/war risks in general, or in relation to the inability of ESL, the customer or any other party related to the carriage or the cargo to obtain insurance, whether war risks insurance or otherwise. If ESL agrees to take on cargoes on this basis, if the customer is unable to obtain relevant insurance, whether war risks or otherwise, the customer remains liable to ESL for any losses, indemnities or contributions which would be covered by such insurance, and the customer agrees that they will provide security in ESL’s favour to cover anticipated losses covered by such insurance, if such security would normally be issued by the customer’s insurer[AP1].

In addition to ESL’s rights under the Bill of Lading, ESL expressly reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to take any steps ESL deems necessary to ensure the safety of our vessels, crew, and your cargo, including and not limited to:

  1. delivering any cargo at a place, deemed by ESL at its sole discretion, to be safe. The customer will then be obligated to take delivery at such a place at their sole risk and expense and without any liability on the part of ESL, whether contractual, civil, economic or otherwise. [AP2]  The customer also warrants, represents and agrees that they will not commence, or pursue any claim(s) against ESL or its associated companies in any jurisdiction whatsoever for any loss or damage that may result from such delivery as aforesaid.
  2. Abandoning the cargo or being unable to deliver the cargo as aforesaid at (i), above, due to the prevailing risks and circumstances. In such a case ESL will not be liable to the customer for any loss or damage whatsoever and howsoever arising from such action and the customer warrants, represents and agrees that they will not commence, or pursue any claim(s) against the ESL or its associated companies in any jurisdiction whatsoever resulting from such action as covered by this (ii).

[AP1] This is to cover GA, Salvage and possibly pollution security that might be covered by the insurers. However, we might want to keep the wording broad so that ESL can call on security that might not normally be covered by insurers.

[AP2] Alternate wording could be as follows, after “sole risk and expense”, add a “.” and the following, “If ESL proceeds to deliver the cargo in this way, the customer agrees that ESL will not be liable for any and all loss, damage, economic or otherwise, whether foreseeable or not, and the customer agrees that it will not pursue ESL for any such loss or damage”
